note: Extension packages are fetched live from the official Termux repository (China-direct mirrors, no pre-bundling). ExtensionManager resolves the dependency closure from each item's "packages" field, then pulls the .deb files from a mirror, verifies them and unpacks/installs them. Version and size are read at runtime from the repository's Packages index.
